name: How should I prepare before an in-home accessibility modification consultation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before an in-home accessibility modification consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an estimate, measure any assistive equipment in use, such as the exact width of wheelchairs or walkers, and list your top daily friction points. Note whether users need seated bathing, side transfers onto the toilet, or zero-step entries. Sharing these specific needs allows HH Remodeling to assess which non-load-bearing walls can be adjusted, what type of non-slip tile surfaces work best, and where blocking should be framed into walls before closing drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure equipment widths, list daily movement challenges, and determine priorities like walk-in showers or widened doors to help guide the initial assessment.
